Financial Tools¶

Overview¶

Financial tools provide specialized calculators and scratchpads for day-to-day and long-term financial planning scenarios.

Available Tools¶

Net Worth Calculator¶

Aggregates all financial accounts:

  • Liquid checking and savings accounts

  • Investment portfolios and retirement funds

  • Real estate and physical assets

  • Outstanding loans and credit card liabilities

  • Real-time net worth computation and tracking

Tip & Split Calculator¶

  • Quick service tip calculation with custom percentages (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, custom).

  • Bill splitting across multiple diners or contributors.

  • Per-person totals with rounding options.

Currency Converter¶

  • Instant offline rate calculation between 20 global currency pairs.

  • Real-time bi-directional conversion.

Loan Amortization Calculator¶

  • Calculate monthly installment payments given loan principal, interest rate, and term duration.

  • Detailed amortization schedules and interest vs. principal payoff breakdowns.

Compound Interest & Savings Growth¶

  • Calculate compound growth with initial principal, monthly contributions, compounding frequencies, and target growth horizons.

  • Interactive growth curves visualizing interest earned over time.

Accessing Tools¶

Navigate to the Tools Hub from the sidebar drawer to access all pinned and active calculators.
